{{Quote|&mdash;didn't Captain Urbok inform me the ''Ackbar''{{'s}} situation was this bad? Damage assessment is her responsibility.''"<br />"''B-because she's dead, s-sir?|Nek Bwua'tu and Yuul during the Battle of the Murgo Choke|audio=Bwuatu-Urbok.flac|<ref name="DNII" />}}
'''Urbok''' was a [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] serving as part of the [[Engineer/Legends|engineering]] staff aboard the [[Victory I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory I''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Admiral Ackbar (Victory-class)|''Admiral Ackbar'']] during the [[Blockade of the Utegetu Nebula|blockade]] of the [[Utegetu Nebula/Legends|Utegetu Nebula]] by the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]]<ref name="DNII" /> in [[36 ABY]].<ref name="Date" /> She served under the command of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Nek Bwua'tu]] of the [[Fifth Fleet (Galactic Alliance)|Galactic Alliance Fifth Fleet]], and was responsible for damage assessment during battles.<ref name="DNII" />

When the [[Gorog|Dark Nest]], a secret nest of [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]], [[Battle of the Murgo Choke|attacked]] the Fifth Fleet at the [[Murgo Choke]], the ''Admiral Ackbar'' suffered heavy damage. Urbok and [[Lieutenant Commander/Legends|Lieutenant Commander]] [[Reo]] were [[Death/Legends|killed]] by Dark Nest [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]] during the battle. [[Ensign/Legends|Ensign]] [[Yuul]], the only member of the engineering staff still capable of carrying out his duties, received a field promotion to Captain and took Urbok's former place.<ref name="DNII" />

==Behind the scenes==
Urbok was mentioned in the [[2005]] novel ''[[Dark Nest II: The Unseen Queen]]'', part of the ''[[Star Wars: The Dark Nest Trilogy|Dark Nest Trilogy]]'' written by [[Troy Denning]].<ref name="DNII" />
